# Kyoto 5-Day Budget Snapshot

For **2 adults** in Kyoto from **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16**, a **180,000 JPY** trip budget excluding flights is workable with a comfortable mid-range pace. The main pressure points are usually **lodging** and **food/activities**.

## Budget Breakdown by Category

| Category | Planned Budget | Share | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Lodging | **75,000 JPY** | 41.7% | 4 nights in a well-located hotel or ryokan-style stay |
| Food | **45,000 JPY** | 25.0% | Mix of casual lunches, nicer dinners, drinks/snacks |
| Local transport | **12,000 JPY** | 6.7% | Subway, buses, occasional taxi |
| Activities | **28,000 JPY** | 15.6% | Temples, gardens, entry fees, one special experience |
| Buffer | **20,000 JPY** | 11.1% | Price swings, extra meals, taxi backup, shopping spillover |
| **Total** | **180,000 JPY** | **100%** |  |

## Itinerary Pacing Chart

| Day | Pace | Focus | Spend Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 12 | Light | Arrival, check-in, nearby dinner, early night | Low |
| Oct 13 | Moderate | Eastern Kyoto temples, walking, one paid attraction | Medium |
| Oct 14 | Moderate | Arashiyama / western Kyoto, scenic stops, lunch out | Medium |
| Oct 15 | Full | Central Kyoto, shopping, cultural activity, nicer dinner | High |
| Oct 16 | Light | Breakfast, last stroll, departure | Low |

## Where Costs Are Most Likely to Run Over

- **Lodging**: highest risk if you want a central hotel, twin room, or ryokan with breakfast.
- **Food**: can rise quickly with sit-down dinners, dessert/cafe stops, and drinks for two.
- **Activities**: overruns happen if you add paid experiences, special gardens, museums, or taxi-heavy routing.
- **Local transport**: usually controlled, but taxis can push this up fast on rainy days or late nights.
- **Buffer**: should stay untouched unless you add shopping, premium meals, or a last-minute booking.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Refine budget] https://www.japan.travel/en/
Action: [Button: Kyoto transit] https://www.jrpass.com/
Action: [Button: Kyoto tourism] https://kyoto.travel/en

## Sources

- Kyoto official tourism: https://kyoto.travel/en
- Japan travel guide: https://www.japan.travel/en/
- JR Pass information: https://www.jrpass.com/
